system.description:
• Effect: Once per day (twice from 15th), inspire one creature with greatness — they have Advantage on their first attack roll each round for the encounter, and gain temporary HP equal to two rolls of their Hit Die.
  • Add their Constitution modifier to each roll
  • The creature must hear the Bard and stay within 30ft
  • Lasts 1 minute plus 1 round per level beyond 9th
  • For every 2 levels beyond 9th, one additional creature can be inspired simultaneously

activities.name: Exhort Greatness
activities.text: One creature within 30ft gains Advantage on its first attack each round and temporary HP equal to two rolls of its Hit Die plus its Constitution modifier on each.
